name: Family Relationships
overview: Scripture reveals that family relationships are founded on God's design for unity and obedience, beginning with the marriage union where a man leaves his parents to become one flesh with his wife (Genesis 2:24). Honoring parents is commanded as a means to receive God's blessing and longevity (Exodus 20:12), while families are called to serve the Lord together, making a deliberate choice to follow Him (Joshua 24:15). Children are recognized as a precious heritage from the Lord, underscoring the divine value placed on family (Psalms 127:3). The faithful meditation on God's law guides family members to live wisely and prosper (Joshua 1:8), fostering godly living and unity within the household (Psalms 1:1).
